MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

2. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 49
   D. 50

3. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 5
   C. 24
   D. 25

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 10
   C. 12
   D. 2

5. Solve for x: x + 5 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 9
   C. 13
   D. 8

6. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 16
   C. 65
   D. 0

7. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 24
   C. 2
   D. 25

8. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 3
   C. 40
   D. 41

9. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 8
   C. 0
   D. 17

10. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 11
   C. 22
   D. 121

11. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

12. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 24
   D. 12

13. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

14. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 170

15. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 57
   C. 1
   D. 56

16. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 36

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
